headline: Gold slips to ~4,040-4,050 into FOMC; rallies still sold
summary: Day range roughly 4,030-4,065: Asia gave back Tuesday's bounce, London held 4,030-4,050.
Oil rose after a Saudi refinery attack claim; USD near 2-week high, gold off ~0.3-0.4%.
Plans A and B were not triggered (high stayed below 4,110, low above 4,010).
FOMC 01:00 BKK: hold expected, Dec hike odds ~77-84%; Warsh tone decides the next move.
Wait until after 02:00 BKK to arm new orders; PCE and GDP at 19:30 BKK Thursday.
events: Thu 19:30 BKK  US Q3 GDP + Sep PCE
